methods.name: deliverable-consistency
methods.description: Check one Chirality deliverable for unresolved markers, missing core artifacts, identity mismatches, cross-document conflicts, and candidate unsourced numeric statements.

methods.name: drawing-titleblock-page
methods.description: Extract titleblock metadata from one drawing page using four corner crops and a full-page thumbnail, then write one governed sheet-inventory stub.

methods.name: preparation
methods.description: Materialize accepted Chirality package, deliverable, category, knowledge-type, or tool-root scope as idempotent folders and source-faithful control files. Use for structural workspace setup, not production-content drafting.

methods.name: proposal-format
methods.description: Express actionable Chirality findings as evidence-grounded PROPOSAL blocks with precise changes, risks, status, and a human-decision interface.

methods.name: researcher
methods.description: Investigate one bounded Chirality research question against an accepted snapshot and retrieval index, producing independently verified evidence and a recoverable research packet.

methods.name: software-code-review
methods.description: Review a bounded software diff for correctness, regressions, scope compliance, contracts, security, maintainability, and verification evidence before implementation fan-in.

methods.name: software-defect-diagnosis
methods.description: Reproduce, isolate, and explain a bounded software defect before repair. Use for failing tests, regressions, runtime errors, performance anomalies, or conflicting symptom reports.

methods.name: aggregation
methods.description: Combine selected records into a traceable cross-scope view, including estimate collation.

methods.name: audit-agents
methods.description: Assess role instructions against a named design basis and propose evidence-linked repairs.

methods.name: audit-decomp
methods.description: Reconcile accepted decomposition with materialized scope and current derivative evidence.

methods.name: audit-dep-closure
methods.description: Explain dependency closure, missing targets, cycles, and coordination concentrations.

methods.name: audit-epistemic
methods.description: Inspect what claims assert, what warrants them, and what uncertainty or conflict affects reliance.

methods.name: audit-governance
methods.description: Compare governance rules, references, terminology, and authority claims with their evidence.

methods.name: audit-hypergraph-closure
methods.description: Assess whether a graph snapshot’s structure and coverage match its declared source basis.

methods.name: audit-scope-closure
methods.description: Follow an accepted amendment through implementation, reruns, and remaining closure obligations.

methods.name: change
methods.description: Prepare and close a coherent Git change with inspectable evidence and existing human decision rights.

methods.name: content-digest
methods.description: Read one deliverable folder and produce a structured 7-section content digest summarizing identity, scope, document kit, dependencies, references, semantic framework, and quality observations.

methods.name: create-workflow
methods.description: Create or revise a reusable Chirality workflow through conversation, package it in the intended library, and verify discovery and readiness for reuse.

methods.name: dbm-concordance-seed
methods.description: Transform raw concordance evidence atoms and risk inventory rows into typed publication concordance candidates for register freeze review.

methods.name: dbm-concordance-verify
methods.description: Post-synthesis cross-section semantic concordance verification for rewritten DBM package outputs.

methods.name: dbm-draft-review
methods.description: Review a human-prepared draft DBM against the governed knowledge base — build review substrate, prepare candidate findings for human disposition.

methods.name: dbm-postauthor-concordance
methods.description: Post-authoring evidence bundle and review for pipeline-produced DBM sections — build review substrate, prepare candidate findings for human readiness judgment.

methods.name: dbm-publish
methods.description: Assemble the full rewritten DBM package from approved section outputs and produce package QA artifacts.

methods.name: dbm-publisher
methods.description: Develop and publish one engineering Design Basis Memorandum from accepted domain state, with frozen planning, section production, post-authoring review, and human acceptance.

metadata.applicability: Develop and publish one Design Basis Memorandum from accepted domain state.

methods.name: dbm-section-publish
methods.description: Publish exactly one rewritten DBM section from approved mapped DOMAIN inputs and emit fixed QA artifacts.

methods.name: decomposition-package-review
methods.description: Review one DOMAIN decomposition package as a closed system for derivative parity, active snapshot completeness, and handoff-state readiness. Use when a root-level remediation or scope-change run needs package-level closure evidence before downstream work or phase advancement.

methods.name: deliverable-consistency
methods.description: Run a deliverable-local consistency sweep across production documents in one deliverable. Use when checking for unresolved markers, missing core artifacts, identity-label mismatches, or candidate unsourced numeric statements.

methods.name: dependency-extract
methods.description: Extract dependency register (Dependencies.csv v3.1) from deliverable source documents using Anchor x Execution edge typing with evidence-first provenance. Setup-pipeline workflow dispatched by WORKING_ITEMS (workflow: project-setup) during project setup.

methods.name: domain-decomp
methods.description: Develop a coherent domain ontology while preserving source meaning, identity, and disagreement.

methods.name: domain-documents
methods.description: Draft knowledge-artifact document set for a DOMAIN Knowledge Type deliverable. Produces KA-* files per the variable artifact schema. DOMAIN pipeline only.

methods.name: domain-engine
methods.description: Integrate a deterministic domain engine with explicit computational coverage and human judgment.

methods.name: domain-hypergraph
methods.description: Discover source-backed domain entities and build a traceable graph projection.

methods.name: domain-prose-validate
methods.description: Independently re-extract one rasterized PDF page's prose, equations, and asset placeholders for downstream extraction-reproducibility comparison (Gate 1.5-P Stage 1).

methods.name: domain-source-atomize
methods.description: Per-dispatch-unit bounded atomization of one slice of one DOMAIN source markdown into IN/OUT/TBD atomic units with dual SourceRefs, content hashes, and vocabulary seeds. Invoked by the WORKING_ITEMS (workflow: domain-decomp) orchestrator for per-skeleton-dispatch-unit fanout in Phase 2.

methods.name: drawing-extract
methods.description: Extract target-specific evidence from engineering drawings through coverage design, bounded visual extraction, deterministic QA, assembly, and recovery.

metadata.applicability: Extract target-specific structured evidence from engineering drawing sets.

methods.name: drawing-extract-page
methods.description: Per-page bounded extraction of structured data from a single engineering drawing page image, using crop-first multiblock VLM reasoning. Drawing-type-aware (PFD implemented; P_AND_ID, ISOMETRIC, GA stubbed). Invoked by the drawing-extract orchestrator for per-page fanout.

methods.name: drawing-titleblock-page
methods.description: Per-page titleblock extraction from drawing sheets using four corner crops and a full-page thumbnail; emits a governed sheet-inventory stub.

methods.name: equation-audit
methods.description: Review extracted display equations with the human, interpret correction notes, apply validated fixes, backcheck changes, and close an immutable audit snapshot.

methods.name: equation-bbox-detect
methods.description: Detect display-equation bounding boxes on one rasterized page PNG using multimodal vision and emit normalized coordinates for downstream cropping. Per-page bounded dispatch invoked by equation-audit during Phase 1 when per-equation crops are enabled.

methods.name: equation-flag-interpret
methods.description: Convert one human-written natural-language correction note about one display equation into a corrected LaTeX expression. Per-flag bounded dispatch invoked by equation-audit during Phase 3a, one TASK per flagged entry whose `description` is prose rather than LaTeX.

methods.name: equipment-costing-extract
methods.description: Extract costing-relevant design basis parameters for equipment matching a target module type list from KA files in a single KTY folder. Use when building equipment costing registers for cost estimation.

methods.name: equipment-extract
methods.description: Extract discrete physical equipment items from Knowledge Artifact files within a single DOMAIN Knowledge Type folder. Use when building per-KTY equipment registers from KA production documents.

methods.name: estimate-prep
methods.description: Generates estimation input package (pricing library, LOE, project parameters, BOE) via two-phase run with PHASE=SCAFFOLD|BOE modes and a human gate between invocations.

methods.name: estimate-snapshot
methods.description: Generate an immutable, provenance-first estimate snapshot for a bounded scope of deliverables and/or packages, writing quarantined artifacts under the estimating tool root. Use for automated estimate runs driven by a validated BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE enum and local pricing sources.

methods.name: evaluation-protocol
methods.description: Coordinate evidence-grounded evaluation, bounded audits, optional scoring, and remediation handoffs.

methods.name: evaluation-report
methods.description: Evaluate one dimension against an accepted rubric and return a supported score.

methods.name: four-documents
methods.description: Maintain and enrich an existing transitional LEGACY_FOUR_DOC kit for a PROJECT or SOFTWARE deliverable through rollback. Never initialize a new production contract.

methods.name: kty-content-remediate
methods.description: Archive, tombstone, verify, and emit disposition evidence for DOMAIN KTY content after an approved scope change without rewriting active Knowledge Artifact content.

methods.name: kty-metadata-align
methods.description: Review and optionally align one DOMAIN Knowledge Type folder's metadata surfaces to approved decomposition truth without rewriting Scoping.md or KA content. Use after regeneration or scope change when `_CONTEXT.md`, `_STATUS.md`, or `_REFERENCES.md` may have drifted.

methods.name: lens-register
methods.description: Generate a matrix-organized, coverage-complete semantic lensing register (_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md) from _SEMANTIC.md + production documents. Setup-pipeline companion to the interactive semantic-lensing workflow.

methods.name: pandid-valve-symbol-instance
methods.description: Extract pixel-anchored P&ID valve symbol instances from prepared tiles using isolated-crop classification before any row may count.

methods.name: pandid-valve-tile
methods.description: OBSOLETE legacy per-tile P&ID valve candidate extraction retained for historical readability; new runs use pandid-valve-symbol-instance.

methods.name: pdf2md
methods.description: Convert a bounded PDF to Markdown in one TASK assignment, using vision and deterministic cleanup and assembly tools.

methods.name: pdf2md-folio-extract
methods.description: Read one rasterized PDF page and emit the visible printed folio label (page number as it appears on the page itself — "47", "xiv", "B-3", or null when no folio is printed).

methods.name: pdf2md-orchestration
methods.description: Coordinate recoverable PDF conversion through page-bounded vision, deterministic cleanup and asset materialization, assembly, and explicit degraded-output review.

metadata.applicability: Convert a PDF into recoverable Markdown and referenced assets through page-bounded work.

methods.name: pdf2md-page
methods.description: LEGACY Markdown-only page transcription for explicitly selected historical PDF resume contracts; new conversion runs use pdf2md-page-full.

methods.name: pdf2md-page-assets
methods.description: LEGACY separate asset discovery from a PDF page image and Markdown sidecar, retained for historical resume contracts; new conversion runs use pdf2md-page-full.

methods.name: pdf2md-page-full
methods.description: Single-page merged VLM pass that produces BOTH the raw Markdown transcription and the bbox-normalized asset JSON from one vision read of the page image. Replaces the prior two-workflow split (pdf2md-page + pdf2md-page-assets) for new dispatches.

methods.name: preparation
methods.description: Materialize accepted scope as predictable folders and source-faithful metadata.

methods.name: project-decomp
methods.description: Turn a project scope into cohesive Packages and bounded Deliverables with explicit objectives and boundaries.

methods.name: project-setup
methods.description: Initialize an accepted project workspace and coordinate its selected setup and estimation phases.

methods.name: proposal-format
methods.description: Structured recommendation output using PROPOSAL blocks with evidence, change, risk, and status fields. Use for any deliverable-local task that surfaces actionable findings.

methods.name: reconciliation
methods.description: Reconcile claims, artifacts, implementation, evidence, lifecycle, and remaining work with accepted project truth.

metadata.applicability: Reconcile claims, evidence, lifecycle, and remaining work across a deliverable corpus.

methods.name: research-orchestration
methods.description: Coordinate bounded research streams, independent verification, recoverable evidence, and synthesis.

methods.name: researcher
methods.description: Investigate one bounded question through independently verified and recoverable evidence.

methods.name: review
methods.description: Guide evidence review and human disposition for a deliverable lifecycle transition.

metadata.applicability: Review evidence and obtain human disposition for a deliverable lifecycle transition.

methods.name: scc-resolution-case
methods.description: Create or update a PKG-00 SCC resolution case that accumulates bounded TASK findings, evidence, human rulings, candidate remedies, and owner-workflow handoffs until DepClosure can verify closure.

methods.name: scope-change
methods.description: Amend accepted decomposition and propagate the consequences through their owning workflows.

methods.name: scope-change-packet
methods.description: Produce a bounded PKG-00 Scope Change Consumable Packet for later human-initiated WORKING_ITEMS (workflow: scope-change) intake; use scc-resolution-case for active SCC resolution receptacles.

methods.name: scope-of-work
methods.description: Initialize, convert, validate, and independently verify one objective-anchored PROJECT/SOFTWARE ScopeOfWork.md under the active SOW_V1 transition contract. Do not use for DOMAIN/KTY or independent schemas, lifecycle changes, or unauthorized corpus conversion.

methods.name: semantic-lensing
methods.description: Apply semantic lensing analysis to deliverable documents using _SEMANTIC.md matrices. Treats lensing entries as a candidate worklist, tags proposals with matrix coordinates, and optionally updates lens artifacts.

methods.name: semantic-matrix-build
methods.description: Generate one deliverable-local semantic lens (_SEMANTIC.md) by adopting canonical matrices A and B and deriving C, F, D, K, G, X, T, and E with explicit semantic-algebra working.

methods.name: software-bounded-implementation
methods.description: Implement one sealed software change within explicit write targets and acceptance criteria, then produce normalized verification evidence. Use for bounded features, repairs, refactors, migrations, or documentation changes after the owning manager freezes scope.

methods.name: software-code-review
methods.description: Review a bounded software diff for correctness, regressions, scope compliance, contracts, security, maintainability, and verification evidence. Use at staged or terminal fan-in before a manager accepts an implementation return.

methods.name: software-decomp
methods.description: Organize software intent into cohesive work domains and implementable bounded contexts.

methods.name: software-defect-diagnosis
methods.description: Reproduce, isolate, and explain a software defect using bounded evidence without assuming repair authority. Use for failing tests, regressions, runtime errors, performance anomalies, or conflicting reports that require a causal diagnosis before implementation.

methods.name: software-repository-reconnaissance
methods.description: Map a software repository's manifests, architecture, test surfaces, commands, ownership boundaries, and risks before planning or implementation. Use for unfamiliar repositories, novel stacks, package activation, or before sealing a software work brief.

methods.name: software-test-planning
methods.description: Derive a risk-based verification plan and affected registered checks for a bounded software change. Use before implementation, at fan-in, or after a defect when test selection, evidence sufficiency, negative cases, or acceptance gates must be made explicit.

methods.name: task-management
methods.description: Make unresolved project obligations visible and carry human dispositions to the owning instruments.

CHANGE.compatibility_note: Legacy CHANGE runs retain the historical change workflow; new Chirality repository change work may select the project-only chirality-change skill.
